text:
Id, songs mías, to the solitario and to the insatisfecho,

id also to the desquiciado, to the slave of the convenciones,

llevadles my desprecio toward your opresores.

Id as a ola gigante of water cold,

llevad my desprecio for the opresores.


Hablad against the oppression inconsciente,

hablad against the tyranny of the that no have imaginación,

hablad against the ataduras,

id to the burguesa that itself is dying of tedio,

id to the women of the barrios residenciales,

id to the repugnantemente casadas,

id to aquellas cuyo fracaso is hidden,

id to the emparejadas without fortuna,

id to the esposa comprada,

id to the woman comprometida.


Id to the that have a lujuria exquisita,

id to aquellos cuyos deseos exquisitos are frustrados,

id as a plaga against the aburrimiento of the world;

id with your filo against esto,

reforzad the sutiles cordones,

traed confianza to the algas and tentáculos of the soul.


Id of manera amistosa,

id with words sinceras.

Ansiad the hallazgo of males new and of a new bien,

oponeos to all the formas of oppression.

Id to quienes the mediana edad has engordado,

to the that have lost the interés.


Id to the adolescentes to quienes les asfixia the familia…

¡Oh, what asqueroso resulta

ver three generaciones reunidas bajo a mismo ceiling!

Is as a tree old with retoños

and with algunas branches podridas and cayéndose.


Salid and desafiad the opinión,

Id against this cautiverio vegetal of the blood.

Id against all the clases of hands muertas.
